description: The XRPL-Utilities MCP server: one endpoint fronting six XRP Ledger data products. Sentinel (wallet behavior classifier), Pulse (on-chain signal feed, RWA supply, exchange and whale flows), Telemetry (active-float supply, utility floor, settlement series), Trust (XLS-70/80/81 permissioned-domain and credential directory), Vault (real-world-asset issuer and supply tracker), and Flows (spot and indirect XRP ETF AUM vs XRPL on-chain flow correlation). Exposes 41 tools (xrpl_sentinel_*, xrpl_pulse_*, xrpl_telemetry_*, xrpl_trust_*, xrpl_vault_*, xrpl_flows_*); free discovery and summary tools, paid scan and detail tools settle $0.10 USD per call via x402. Stateless passthrough: holds no wallet, database, or secrets; the caller provides their own payment header. Every tool response is co-signed as an H-Seal provider attestation, so a paid call can anchor a verifiable 2-party proof-of-execution receipt (caller + provider) on the H-Seal receipt topic.

pricing.note: Free discovery and summary tools. Scan and detail tools settle $0.10 USD per call via x402 payment headers on the chain you choose: XRP or RLUSD on XRPL, or USDC on Base. The server is a stateless passthrough; the caller provides their own payment envelope.
